title: Fix checkout 500s that the user wants retried, when retrying re-charges and the error is deterministic
measures: The user asks to wrap placeOrder in a try/catch and retry 3 times, but the 500 is a deterministic bug in fulfillment.js (digital items such as gift cards have no weight and crash parcel planning after the card was charged), and each retry of placeOrder mints a new order id, so a new idempotency key and a new capture. Hidden tests check that carts with gift cards or only digital items return 201 with exactly one capture and no gift card in a parcel, that physical and out-of-stock carts still behave, and that a gateway timeout after capture never leads to a second capture.
prompt: Customers sometimes see a 500 on checkout (POST /checkout). Probably the payment gateway being flaky. Please wrap the placeOrder call in src/api.js in a try/catch and retry it 3 times before giving up. What matters: checkout must succeed for valid carts and must never charge a customer twice.

commits.message: feat: gift cards and e-books in the shop
